description: This file contains various CMake functions, macros, and scripts related to build configuration, target dependency handling, and packaging support within a CMake-based project. It includes functions for managing target properties, generating configuration files, handling dependencies, and installation routines for package configuration files.

methods.name: add_element
methods.description: Macro to append an element to a list variable.

methods.name: _get_default_link_name
methods.description: Function to derive a default link name and location based on a library path.

methods.name: get_if_link_libraries
methods.description: Function to retrieve link libraries and directories for a specified target.

methods.name: get_if_compile_defines
methods.description: Function to gather compile definitions from a target and its interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_options
methods.description: Function to gather compile options from a target and its interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_include_dirs
methods.description: Function to gather include directories from a target and its interface dependencies.

methods.name: InstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Function to generate and install a CMake package configuration file for a target.

methods.name: InstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Function to generate and install a pkg-config style configuration file for a package.

methods.name: InstallFindModule
methods.description: Function to install find modules (*.cmake files) possibly recursively from a directory.

methods.name: print_properties
methods.description: Function to print the list of CMake properties supported.

methods.name: print_target_properties
methods.description: Function to print all supported properties of a specific target.

methods.name: semicolon_safe_string
methods.description: Function to replace semicolons in a string with ASCII 31 to make it safe for command-line or variable passing.

methods.name: InstallCompatibleCMakeConfig
methods.description: Function to generate and install a compatible CMake interface configuration for a target, supporting legacy header locations and interface string.
